hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has fled to Miami via Argentina, declaring himself the legitimate leader of Brazil in exile while defying Supreme Court orders. The flight has ignited international diplomatic turmoil between Brazil, Argentina, and the US, while provoking intense legal actions and bitter internal leadership rivalries within the Liberal Party.
hotspots.affect: Commands intense global coverage due to sensational claims of election theft, high-stakes flight from prosecution, and polarizing transnational political fallout.

hotspots.title: PiS Internal Crisis Over Kaczyński's Polexit Remarks
hotspots.blurb: Tensions surrounding Law and Justice (PiS) reached boiling point following Jarosław Kaczyński's warnings of a potential EU exit and a dramatic physical standoff at the Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw. President Karol Nawrocki cut short an official visit to Senegal to join PiS politicians rallying outside the cordoned-off court, accusing the government of a legal coup d'état after police blockaded suspended justices.
hotspots.affect: Dominates news cycles through physical confrontation at state institutions, allegations of a constitutional coup, and severe intra-party ideological friction.

hotspots.title: SD Internal Feud Over Swedish Identity Principles
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson has issued a harsh ultimatum to party members advocating ethnic nationalism, demanding they accept 'open Swedishness' or leave the party entirely. The confrontation was ignited by public clashes between key figures Mattias Karlsson and Richard Jomshof, creating an unprecedented internal rift over core ideological principles.
hotspots.affect: Drives intense media heat due to public ideological warfare among top party figures and aggressive purge threats from party leadership.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage sparked widespread controversy by claiming he skipped the parliamentary Budget session to avoid a physical altercation with Lib Dem MP Caroline Voaden, who vehemently accused him of bullying and shoving her in the House of Commons. The party is simultaneously engulfed in damage control after Farage's former campaign security guard was convicted of rape, alongside heated local election clashes.
hotspots.affect: Draws heavy affective engagement through personal political combat in parliament, high-profile criminal scandals, and explosive partisan mudslinging.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen and Rassemblement National face fierce political backlash after a deadly racist attack in Yvelines, with opponents linking the violence to party rhetoric after homemade RN material was found on the shooter. RN has launched aggressive defamation lawsuits while navigating ongoing judicial uncertainty surrounding Le Pen's eligibility for the 2027 presidential election.
hotspots.affect: Captures high media charge due to moral condemnation around violent hate crimes, media litigation battles, and existential presidential campaign stakes.
